definitions.explanation: The biological system consisting of the brain, spinal cord, and nerves, which transmits signals throughout the body and coordinates sensation, movement, and thought.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (nerve) and ⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧ (system). A standard biological/medical term, used in both technical writing and general educated conversation.

USAGE:
- Used as a plain noun, most often with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ in attributive position: {神経系|しんけいけい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧.
- Regularly compounded with other terms: ⟦{中枢|ちゅうすう}→中枢：11373_chuusuu⟧{神経系|しんけいけい} (central nervous system), ⟦{自律|じりつ}→自律：13955_jiritsu⟧{神経系|しんけいけい} (autonomic nervous system).
